It ends with a booked day and time, but the appointment format flips from an agreed phone call to in-person without a clean re-confirmation, leaving a soft procedural gap at the close.
outcome_dispute: V1 outcome context is unclear; based on the transcript this is a booked appointment with day AND time captured (Tuesday the 11th, 10am), so 'booked' is the correct read — but the channel (phone vs in-person) is unresolved at the moment of button-up, which is a fragility flag on an otherwise solid outcome.
